title: budgets
prerequisites: Check v1.budgets supported, enabled, granted and ready; execute only with all required authorization.

operations.summary: Set an installed applet's money limits (all the owner's phones share them): each {id?, usd 0.01-100, per hour|day|week|month, check_at?}; within the owner's ceiling
Add money to one limit of an installed applet for the current period only (it ends at the reset); stopped checks resume at once

Change how often one action of an installed applet runs (every_s within the action's min_s..max_s), on every phone; the running watches change in place and keep their counts. dry_run returns the new projection without saving

boundaries: Documented public API; owner switches, grants and runtime checks still apply.
